# SI018 — severity-from-llm-without-floor

Severity needs a deterministic floor table.

## Why

Letting the model choose severity freely makes the band wobble and turns a policy finding into an opinion.

## Bad

```python
severity = parsed["severity"]
```

## Good

```python
severity = max(parsed_severity, _severity_floor(claim))
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI018 -- reason
```
